clips.title: The story
paras: Kadrak sends couriers from the northern Barrens to gather reports across Ashenvale. The Warsong Reports carry orders and field observations from outriders near Azshara, Splintertree Post, and the Zoram Strand.

Kadrak watches the mountain pass between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale from a fortified tower. The Horde needs the pass because the Barrens cannot supply the timber Orgrimmar requires. The Warsong clan has pushed into the ancient elven forest to reach those supplies. Couriers carry orders between scattered patrols and help keep them in step, while night elf ambushes threaten the wilderness trails.

Warsong scouts watch three parts of Ashenvale. On the western coast, a runner at Zoram'gar Outpost watches naga activity and other coastal threats along the Zoram Strand. At Splintertree Post, a scout coordinates defense against Sentinel raids. Farther east, an outrider watches the road toward the shattered ruins of Azshara. Their reports give Kadrak a view of night elf movements and weaknesses along the frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.
Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hurry, friend. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
